system.description: Can kill you with their mind. Build from heroes successfully Attacked by Skeeterbots in Scene 1. (1 per DNA-sampled hero of matching archetype.)
system.tactics: Mimic the copied hero; choose two abilities from the listed options, or make one up that mimics something the hero is good at.

system.description: Choose two abilities: Mind Blast: +1 to Attack actions. | Confusion: Hinder two targets with the same roll. | Illusion: Defend yourself with a +1 bonus. This defense does not expire until you are attacked and use it.
